summary: Plan competency-based early learning, document child progress and apply positive guidance. Explore the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Early childhood curriculum design, assessment and positive discipline connect developmental competencies with play, observation and guidance. For educators, curriculum leads and supervisors, this training covers mapping outcomes across developmental domains, planning adaptable play-based activities, and documenting progress with observation notes, checklists and portfolios. It also introduces MELQO tools and ABC behavior analysis to inform next-step support and positive guidance in everyday routines.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who plan, assess or supervise learning and care for young children. It suits people who need to connect play, developmental evidence, family knowledge and positive guidance in their daily practice.
prerequisites: Recommended prior experience: work in an early childhood care or education setting, with familiarity planning activities or observing young children. No coding or programming is required. Advanced evaluation concepts, including MELQO use for program review, are introduced for operational awareness rather than implementation training.
